detail: This commit brings the Python, Go, Java, .NET, Ruby, and PHP backend SDKs to the hermetic parity Node and Rust already had: outbound exchange capture with responses, identical bounds and at-source redaction, the determinism envelope and commit identity, and a REPROIT_REPLAY serve mode with the shared divergence marker. It corrects no shipped runtime defect in the product; the SDKs previously captured evidence and could not re-execute, which was their documented state. Each language proves the contract with its own four-verdict acceptance script driving the real CLI.
